arcades.info_text: One of the few known locations in Germany with any arcade games. / Due to gambling laws, until 2003 video games were classified the same as gambling machines, only available to those over the age of 18. Gambling casinos did get the occasional game, but they are not allowed to advertise in the paper or on the net. Therefore machine locations were only available via word of mouth. / Now it is easier to get a license to have traditional video games, but the law was reversed so late in the day. Arcades were already in decline so no point to open new ones. / This place can be found directly via a subway exit from the main station.

There is a prevalent CD-ROM error which plagues the machine especially when it comes to loading songs before beginning a song stage sometimes outright freezing entirely, prompting for a reboot to be done by the arcade attendant.
